back_translation: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the festivals come round in their cycles.
Then I will press Ariel hard; there will be mourning and lamentation, and that city will be to Me like an altar hearth.
I will encamp against you all around; I will besiege you with siege towers and raise up siegeworks against you.

You will be brought low; you will speak from the ground, and your words will come faint and low out of the dust. Your voice will be like the voice of a medium's spirit out of the ground, and your words will whisper up from the dust.
But the horde of your enemies will become like fine dust, and the horde of the ruthless like chaff blowing away. Then suddenly, in the blink of an eye,
the LORD of Hosts will come to visit you with thunder, earthquake, and a thunderous sound, with whirlwind, storm, and a flame of devouring fire.
And the horde of all the nations that wage war against Ariel — all who attack her and her fortress and press her hard — will be like a dream, like a vision of the night.

It will be as when a hungry man dreams that he is eating but wakes with his stomach still empty, and as when a thirsty man dreams that he is drinking but wakes still faint and parched with thirst. So will it be for the horde of all the nations that wage war against Mount Zion.
Be stunned and bewildered; make yourselves blind and unseeing. They are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger, but not from strong drink.
For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes — the prophets — and covered your heads — the seers.
And this entire vision has become to you like the words of a sealed scroll. When it is handed to one who can read, saying, "Please read this," he answers, "I cannot, for it is sealed."
Or when the scroll is handed to one who cannot read, saying, "Please read this," he answers, "I cannot read."

The Lord said: "Because this people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me, and the fear they have toward Me is merely a human precept memorized and passed on,
therefore, behold, I will again do wonders with this people, wonder upon wonder. The wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their discerning men will be hidden."
Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. Their deeds are in darkness, and they say, "Who sees us? Who will know?"

How perverse of you! Shall the potter be regarded as the clay? Shall the thing made say of its maker, "He did not make me"? Shall the thing formed say of the one who formed it, "He has no understanding"?
Is it not yet a very little while until Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful orchard, and the fruitful orchard will be counted as a forest?
In that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and the eyes of the blind will see out of gloom and out of thick darkness.
The humble will rejoice in the LORD all the more, and the poor among mankind will be glad in the Holy One of Israel.
For the ruthless will come to nothing, the scoffers will vanish, and all who watch for a chance to do evil will be cut off —

those who incriminate a person with a single word, who lay a snare for the one who speaks the truth in correction at the city gate, and who twist aside the justice of the righteous with empty accusations.
Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says this to the house of Jacob: "Jacob will no longer be ashamed, and his face will no longer grow pale.

For when he sees his children, the work of My hands, in his midst, they will treat My name as holy; they will treat the Holy One of Jacob as holy and will stand in awe and reverence of the God of Israel.
Those who are wayward in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will accept instruction."
